# HAX webcomponents

> The haxtheweb/webcomponents monorepo: LitElement web components, HAXcms themes and the DDD design system used by HAX (Headless Authoring eXperience). Every element lives in `elements/<package>/`.

Start with `AGENTS.md`. Before building a new element, check whether one already exists.

## Core resources

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Rules for AI agents working in this monorepo.
- [elements-catalog.json](elements-catalog.json): Every element with its title, description, package, import path, HAX type (`element` or `grid`) and tags, plus a short list of preferred building blocks. Search it with `hax wc --search <words>`. Generated by `scripts/build-elements-catalog.mjs`.
- [hax-elements-registry.json](hax-elements-registry.json): Tags and titles of HAX-capable elements.
- [hax-webcomponent-dev skill](https://github.com/haxtheweb/create/blob/main/src/skills/hax-webcomponent-dev/SKILL.md): How to build a HAX element: before-you-build checks, preferred building blocks, haxProperties, dark mode, and what `hax audit` enforces.
- [HAXSchema reference](elements/hax-body-behaviors/lib/HAXWiring.js): The haxProperties format and haxHooks, documented at the top of the file.
- [DDD design system](elements/d-d-d): Design tokens for spacing, color, typography and more.

## Optional

- [Workflow skills (PRAW)](https://github.com/haxtheweb/praw/tree/main/skills): Design system, accessibility, content authoring and other HAX skills.
- [HAX CLI](https://github.com/haxtheweb/create): `hax webcomponent`, `hax audit`, `hax wc --search`.
- [Issues](https://github.com/haxtheweb/issues): The unified issue queue for the HAX ecosystem.
